name: Sarda Energy and Minerals Ltd.
about: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited produces and sells steel products in India and internationally. The company product portfolio includes pellets, sponge iron, steel billets and wire rods, ferro alloys, eco-bricks, and HB wires. It is also involved in coal and iron ore mining, as well as operation of hydro, thermal, and solar power plants. Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Raipur, India.
